My independent status sweep over all 65 declared http_status bindings reports zero mismatches (iteration-01 re-check still fires on exactly the one known defect), and the new attempt_record_status check reproduces that split. Falsification attempt on the check: no missed mismatch; five 2026-09-24-vintage bindings have no .headers sidecar/current-manifest entry for it to read, and each was manually reconciled as declared-correct (no defect). Traceability: all 109 payload sha256 instances resolve to on-disk bytes. Weekend semantics clean: every last bar is 2026-10-02 and no Oct 3/4 price is claimed. Calendar rows trace to the bound pipeline artifact, StatCan schedule and UMich page and are labeled pipeline-sourced; no Oct 2 Employment Situation row. Render verified independently (headless Chrome: Fed card "3.88% October monthly (30-day) average EFFR", BoC card "2.346% quarterly average CORRA", dovish payrolls card, no fabricated odds, NO TRADE / NO EDGE) and the shipped render test passes 9/9 with data/latest.json restored (git clean). Brief: headline and all round-facing sections freshly rewritten and accurate; two minor non-blocking notes recorded (authoring-note wording overstates retention; gate coverage limit for legacy records). Decision usefulness: a disciplined weekend abstention worth a PM's 90 seconds - nothing new to price, a dated confirmation sequence (ISM services Oct 5, minutes Oct 7, claims Oct 8, Canada LFS + Michigan Oct 9), dated falsifiers, and the stale >70% media odds clearly attributed as pre-payrolls context. No material findings.

Chasing Friday's front-end rally (ZN +0.25% on the payroll window) without a second confirming print; the repricing can retrace on services or claims.
Duration trap: the long end shrugged off the weak labor data this week (TLT -2.32% w) - a duration-long built on soft data alone can lose again.
BoC asymmetry: the empty hawkish column is absence of evidence, not evidence; a strong Ivey print or trade rebound (Oct 6) removes the dovish lean with no new BoC communication.
